lines.zh: 低吟前行，满身绿辉闪烁。
lines.en: Muttering as it walks, green glow flickers across its body.

lines.zh: 啃食藤蔓，咀嚼声清晰可闻。
低语前行，眼中闪烁绿光。
lines.en: Whispers as it moves, eyes glowing green.
Eats from the ground, green light spreads.
Moves slowly, green light surrounds it.
Mumbles, green light flickers in eyes.

lines.zh: 啃食苔藓，发出低沉声响。
lines.en: Chews on moss, makes low sounds.

lines.zh: 啃食发光蘑菇，绿光环绕。
lines.en: Eats glowing mushrooms, green light surrounds.

lines.zh: 低吟前行，地精之王的气息。
lines.en: Muttering, the air of a Groglin Chieftain.
Empty eyes, looks deep in thought.
Bends down to eat, green light flickers.
Eats decayed grass, green light faint.

lines.zh: 舔舐伤口，发出细微声音。

lines.en: Mumbles to itself, seems speaking to air.

lines.zh: 啃食地底根茎，绿光环绕。
lines.en: Eats underground roots, green light surrounds.

lines.zh: 啃食腐烂树叶，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Chews on rotten leaves, makes rustling sound.

lines.zh: 啃食苔藓，发出轻微声响。
lines.en: Chews on moss, makes soft noise.
It lays its spear across its knees.
It mutters at the stone wall.
It counts rune shards in its nest.
It gnaws a glowing mushroom stalk.
It sharpens its spearhead on a claw.
Stares at you, green light in eyes.
Locks gaze, green light like blades.
Stares at player, green light flickers.
Green light in eyes, locking target.
Eyes like torches, green light flickers.
Sharp eyes, green light like daggers.
Green light flickers, staring at player.
Green light in eyes, locking prey.
Green light like torches, staring at you.
Green light gathers in its pupils.

lines.zh: 你的攻击让我感到疼痛！
我的盔甲闪烁着黑曜石光芒。
lines.en: My armor glimmers with obsidian light.

lines.zh: 你看起来像是我的新午餐。
lines.en: You look like my new lunch.

lines.zh: 我会让你明白恐惧的滋味。
守护者之光不会轻易熄灭。

lines.en: Don't try to get close to me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子足够将你撕碎。
lines.en: My claws are enough to tear you apart.

lines.zh: 躲开！我的力量无处不在。
lines.en: Avoid me! My power is everywhere.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精的地道，只够一人过。
lines.en: Groglin tunnels fit only one at a time.

lines.zh: 我们的碰撞注定要发生。
我的盔甲是坚不可摧的。
地道太窄，我的肩撞在壁上。
lines.en: The tunnel's too narrow — my shoulder hits the wall.

lines.zh: 我的存在就是力量的象征。
lines.en: My existence is a symbol of power.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣可以更加强大。
我寻找的是更强的个体。
我的伴侣拥有无尽力量。
我们共同变得更加强大。
拾起一个黑暗的地精符文。
lines.en: Pick up a dark goblin rune.

lines.zh: 抓起一个古老的符文碎片。
拾起一个浑浊的矿石块。
lines.en: Pick up a murky ore block.
My spear tip turns to follow your shadow.
Acquire a player in the distance.

lines.zh: 锁定一个正在逃跑的生物。
锁定一个快速逼近的敌人。
锁定一个正在攻击的玩家。
锁定一个正在挖掘的玩家。
锁定一个快速逼近的玩家。

lines.en: The chieftain lets out a low growl.
The green glow fixes on your position.
It points one claw at you.

lines.zh: 洞穴里响起召集的低吟
lines.en: A summoning hum rolls through the cave.
It knows an intruder when it sees one.
It stamps its spear butt on the floor.
The green glimmer lights up its tusks.
It raises the spear past its shoulder.
Green light gathers at the spear tip.
It circles you, hunting for a gap.
Its claw tightens on the shaft.
It waits for you to slip.
The chieftain hisses off the paces.
The spear tip hovers before your eyes.
It cracks a floor tile underfoot.
Green light runs from spear to wrist.

lines.zh: 挥舞长矛，地精首领嘶吼！
挥剑攻击，地精首领咆哮！
近身一击，地精首领嘶嘶！
举起巨剑，地精首领咆哮！
长矛扫击，地精首领嘶嘶！
挥斧攻击，地精首领嘶嘶！
长剑穿刺，地精首领嘶嘶！
挥棒砸击，地精首领嘶嘶！
挥舞巨剑，地精首领嘶嘶！
挥动长矛，地精首领嘶嘶！

lines.en: The spear stabs straight at your chest.
It swings the spear in a wide arc.
Its claws tear through your armor.
It rams the spear butt into your ribs.

lines.zh: 从洞穴中出现，地精首领！
从地穴中爬出，地精首领！
lines.en: Crawls out of hole, Groglin Chieftain.

lines.zh: 从地下裂缝中现身，地精首领！
从地下巢穴中走出，地精首领！
lines.en: Walks out of lair, Groglin Chieftain.
Steps out of darkness, Groglin Chieftain.

lines.zh: 从洞穴出口现身，地精首领！
lines.en: Appears from cave entrance, Groglin Chieftain.

lines.zh: 从地下通道走出，地精首领！
lines.en: Walks out from tunnel, Groglin Chieftain.

lines.zh: 从地底深处走出，地精首领！
lines.en: Walks out from depths, Groglin Chieftain.

lines.zh: 从地下洞穴中走出，地精首领！
lines.en: Walks out from cave, Groglin Chieftain.

lines.zh: 从地底深处现身，地精首领！
地精首领从苔藓里站起
lines.en: The chieftain rises out of the moss.
A pair of green eyes surfaces in the gloom.
It drags its spear out of the dark.
Drumbeats echo from deep in the burrow.
The chieftain is here — keep your head down!
The moss splits and it climbs out.
It settles onto that flat stone.
Green light fills the whole burrow.

lines.zh: 它宣布这里是它的地盘
lines.en: It declares this place its own.
A new claw mark joins the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我被你从高处摔了下来！

lines.en: The chief's armor has been blasted open.
An arrow is stuck in the gap of my shoulder plate!
